name: Bandwidth Unlimited
summary: Canberra TransACT-only broadband brand ('bU', bu.net.au, opened 5 May 2003; $100/mo unlimited); operated by CBIT Internet's Paul Hampson; formally taken over by CBIT Internet 3 Nov 2005.

events.details: Opened as a TransACT-only broadband provider.
Taken over by CBIT Internet: site notice reads 'CBIT Internet have taken over the operations from November 3rd 2005'; existing customers referred to CBIT's Paul Hampson (paul@cbit.com.au).
